notion.description: Notion workspace pages and databases: search, read, create, and update. Use it for any notion.so link.

pappers.description: French company registry (Pappers): SIREN lookup, company details, financial statements, executives, beneficial owners, legal texts, court decisions, and land parcels.

logfire.description: Pydantic Logfire observability: SQL over traces, spans, logs, and metrics, plus dashboards, alerts, and exception issues. Use it for any logfire link.

brandfetch.description: Brand assets from Brandfetch: logos, icons, colors, and fonts for a company or domain.

plain.description: Plain customer-support workspace: threads, customers, companies, tenants, labels, and replies. Use it for any app.plain.com link.

posthog.description: PostHog product analytics: events, insights, dashboards, feature flags, experiments, session replays, error tracking, and SQL queries. Use it for any posthog.com link.

postgres.description: Local zefire PostgreSQL database (localhost:5432/zefire, unrestricted access): schemas, objects, SQL execution, query plans, and index and health analysis.

aws.description: AWS through the official AWS MCP server, read-only with the rnx-readonly profile: AWS API calls, S3 presigned URLs, AWS documentation, and region availability. Use it instead of the AWS CLI.

playwright.description: Playwright browser automation: navigate, click, fill forms, take snapshots and screenshots, and inspect console and network.

greptile.description: Greptile AI code reviews: review status and comments on pull and merge requests, and custom review context for indexed repositories.

excalidraw.description: Excalidraw+ workspace: collections, scenes and their content, users, and invites. Use it for any excalidraw.com or plus.excalidraw.com link.

sentry.description: Sentry error monitoring: issues, events, logs, traces, replays, and Seer root-cause analysis. Use it for any sentry.io link.

imagekit-dam.description: ImageKit digital asset management: files, folders, tags, custom metadata, collections, and asset access.

imagekit-admin.description: ImageKit account administration: origins, URL endpoints, webhooks, and account usage.

auth0.description: Auth0 tenant management: applications, APIs (resource servers), actions, forms, and logs.

context7.description: Context7 up-to-date library and framework documentation and code examples.

newrelic.description: New Relic observability: NRQL queries over APM, logs, traces, alerts, and entities.

cloudflare-api.description: Cloudflare account through the full Cloudflare API: Workers, DNS, zones, R2, KV, D1, and other resources.

superlogical.description: Rex (Superlogical terminal multiplexer) community knowledge, read-only: docs, changelog and release notes, and Rex Beta Discord discussions.

wispr-flow.description: Wispr Flow meetings, notes, transcripts, and calendar. Use it (not fetch_content) for any https://notes.wisprflow.ai/shared/... link.
